item.title: Plan First, Code Second: How Agentic Coding Changed the Way I Work
item.author: mattnorberg4@gmail.com (Matthew Norberg)
item.description: I write less code than I used to and spend more time guiding AI tools toward the solution. Here’s the workflow I’ve landed on: start with a conversation instead of code, build up a set of markdown docs that both people and AI tools rely on, and use a few key ideas in the instructions file to tie it all together.
